{"class": "architectural",
 "chokepoint": [
  {"operator": "fd_read of SRC data into linear memory", "component": "WASI fd_read", "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "preview1 offers no clone, splice or copy call, and a hard link is not a copy, so all 512 MiB must enter linear memory via fd_read",
   "least_work": {"amount": 536870912, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 67.11,
                  "calling_context": "large (>=1 MiB) buffers, warm page cache, native read rate ~8 GB/s with no per-call overhead counted"},
   "max_cores": 1},
  {"operator": "fd_write of DST data out of linear memory", "component": "WASI fd_write", "frozen": true,
   "why_every_version_executes_it": "DST must contain all 512 MiB, and the only frozen path out of linear memory is fd_write",
   "least_work": {"amount": 536870912, "unit": "bytes", "per_unit_cost_us": 0.000125, "total_ms": 67.11,
                  "calling_context": "large (>=1 MiB) buffers, native write rate ~8 GB/s with no per-call overhead counted"},
   "max_cores": 1}
 ],
 "floor_ms": 67.11,
 "L_delta": 2.636,
 "rationale": "GNU uses a FICLONE reflink and moves no data. Under wasip1 every version must fd_read and fd_write all 512 MiB. Each costs at least 67.1 ms at 8 GB/s and runs on one core (single-threaded). L = max(134.2/4, 67.1) = 67.1 ms. ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64, well above the band of 0.236. Bigger buffers and precompilation cut overhead but cannot remove the data movement."}
